text: This report recommends that City Council approve the alterations to and the demolition of attributes proposed for the William Weeks House at 94 Cortleigh Boulevard (designated under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act), in connection with a new one-storey addition at the rear of the property. The subject property is in the Lytton Park neighbourhood, on the north side of Cortleigh Boulevard between Avenue Road and Rosewell Avenue and backs onto the Lytton Sunken Gardens Park. The property contains the residence constructed in 1914 for William Weeks. Inspired by the Arts and Crafts movement, the two-storey house is finished in rustic red brick, stone detailing, and has half-timbered gables. An extended roof slope bisects and distinguishes the main façade, which also features a prominent stone porch.
